findings.text: The change removes the app-level `Action` that called `helpCommand`. Running `asdf` with no arguments now falls through to urfave/cli's default app help, and it exits 0. Before, it printed asdf's own help with the installed plugins. `CommandNotFound` only fires when an unknown command name is given, so the no-argument case is no longer handled.
